name: switch
title: Switch
description: A native checkbox drawn as a switch, with a thumb that stretches on press and springs across.

.rx-switch.background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--_sheen), transparent 60%) padding-box, linear-gradient(var(--_fill), var(--_fill)) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, var(--_edge-a), var(--_edge-b)) border-box, linear-gradient(var(--_fill), var(--_fill)) border-box

.rx-switch::before.transition: inset-inline-start var(--spring-switch-duration) var(--spring-switch), width var(--spring-switch-duration) var(--spring-switch), scale var(--spring-switch-duration) var(--spring-switch), background-color 200ms var(--motion-ease)
